body.objective: Students will be able to talk about future plans and careers.
body.iCan: I can talk about future plans and careers.
successCriteria: I can name professions in Spanish with masculine and feminine forms
I can talk about my future using voy a ser and quiero ser
I can explain my choice with reasons and skills
body.hook: "De grande, quiero ser veterinaria." Talking about your future, and the careers that interest you, is one of the most personal conversations you can have in a new language.

study.title: Mi futuro
study.question: What careers interest me and why?
study.passage:
Guide (written for this lesson):
Patterns: -o → -a (médico, médica; abogado, abogada); -or → -ora (profesor, profesora; programador, programadora); -ista same for both (el/la periodista, el/la artista, el/la dentista); -e often same (el/la estudiante).
No article after ser with professions: Mi madre es enfermera.
Future: Voy a ser ingeniera. Quiero ser piloto. Me gustaría ser chef. Voy a estudiar en la universidad.
Reasons and skills: porque me gustan los animales; porque soy creativo/a; porque quiero ayudar a la gente; porque soy bueno/a en matemáticas.
Model: De grande, quiero ser veterinaria porque me encantan los animales y soy paciente. Voy a estudiar biología en la universidad. Me gustaría trabajar en una clínica en Red Deer.
Activity: career interview: ¿Qué quieres ser? ¿Por qué? ¿Qué vas a estudiar? ¿Dónde te gustaría trabajar? Then report on a partner.
study.source: Original model written for this lesson.
steps: Use voy a ser and quiero ser
Interview and report on a partner
discussion: Which professions don't change for gender?
What does your partner want to be, and why?
What skills does your dream job need?
study.product: Write a paragraph about your future career with a profession, three reasons or skills, what you'll study and where you'd like to work.

body.objective: Students will be able to narrate past events with the preterite.
body.iCan: I can narrate past events with the preterite.
successCriteria: I can form the preterite of regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs
I can use common irregular preterites (ir, ser, hacer, tener)
I can narrate past events with time expressions
body.hook: "Ayer fui al cine, comí palomitas y vi una película increíble." To tell stories about the past, Spanish uses the preterite, the tense of completed actions.

study.title: ¿Qué hiciste?
study.question: How do I talk about the past in Spanish?
study.passage:
Preterite (written for this lesson):
-ar (hablar): hablé, hablaste, habló, hablamos, hablaron.
-er/-ir (comer, vivir): comí, comiste, comió, comimos, comieron; viví, viviste, vivió, vivimos, vivieron.
Watch the accents: hablo (I speak) vs habló (he spoke).
Irregular: ir and ser share forms: fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fueron (context tells which). hacer: hice, hiciste, hizo, hicimos, hicieron. tener: tuve, tuviste, tuvo, tuvimos, tuvieron.
Spelling in yo: jugar → jugué, practicar → practiqué, llegar → llegué.
Text: El fin de semana pasado fue muy divertido. El sábado, jugué al fútbol con mis amigos y ganamos. Después, fuimos a una pizzería y comimos mucho. Por la noche, vi una película con mi familia. El domingo, hice la tarea y llamé a mi abuela. ¡Tuve un fin de semana fantástico!
Activity: "¿Qué hiciste ayer?": interview three classmates and write a summary using él/ella forms.
study.source: Original text written for this lesson.
steps: Learn ir, ser, hacer and tener
discussion: What did the writer do on Saturday?
How do you tell fui (I went) from fui (I was)?
What did your classmates do yesterday?
study.product: Write a paragraph about last weekend with at least eight preterite verbs, including three irregular ones and two time expressions.

practice.a: The past tense for completed actions.

practice.q: How do you tell hablo from habló?
practice.a: The accent: habló is past (he spoke).
To keep the hard g sound before e.

practice.q: Translate: Last year we went to Mexico.
practice.a: El año pasado fuimos a México.

exitTicket: Give the preterite of ir for yo and ella.

items.answer: D) I went or I was

body.objective: Students will be able to compare past and future.
body.iCan: I can compare past and future.
successCriteria: I can contrast past events and future plans in one presentation
I can use the preterite and ir a + infinitive accurately
I can reflect on my Spanish learning
body.hook: Your Spanish journey has a past and a future. In this final project, you'll connect them: where you've been, what you've done and where you're going, all in Spanish.

study.title: Mi pasado y mi futuro
study.question: How do I compare my past and my future in Spanish?
study.passage:
Project guide (written for this lesson):
Part 1, el pasado (preterite): one memorable event (a trip, a celebration, an achievement): El verano pasado, fui a… Aprendí a… Ganamos…
Part 2, el presente (present): who you are now: Ahora estoy en noveno grado. Me gusta… Practico…
Part 3, el futuro (ir a + infinitive): plans for next year and your career: El próximo año, voy a… De grande, voy a ser…
Part 4, mi español: what you learned in Spanish 7–9 and your goals: En la clase de español, aprendí a presentarme, a pedir comida en un restaurante y a hablar del medio ambiente. Voy a seguir estudiando español porque… Mi meta es viajar a…
Format: 2–3 minute presentation or video with a timeline visual (photos or drawings).
Peer questions: ¿Qué fue lo mejor de tu viaje? ¿Qué vas a estudiar?
Rubric: content, preterite accuracy, future accuracy, vocabulary range, pronunciation, visuals, reflection.
study.source: Original project written for this lesson.
discussion: Which tense was hardest to use correctly?
What memorable event did you choose?
What are your goals for Spanish?
What are you proudest of learning?
study.product: Present a 2–3 minute past-present-future timeline in Spanish with a reflection on your Spanish learning.

examples.title: Past
examples.problem: "Last summer I went to Banff and I saw a bear."
examples.answer: El verano pasado fui a Banff y vi un oso.

examples.title: Present
examples.problem: "Now I'm in grade 9 and I play volleyball."
examples.answer: Ahora estoy en noveno grado y juego al voleibol.

examples.title: Future
examples.problem: "Next year I'm going to take Spanish 10."
examples.answer: El próximo año voy a tomar español 10.

examples.title: Reflection
examples.problem: "In Spanish class, I learned to order food."
examples.answer: En la clase de español, aprendí a pedir comida.

practice.q: Which tense is used for the past event?

practice.a: It shows past, present and future clearly.

practice.q: Translate: When I was a child, I lived in Toronto. Now I live in Calgary.
practice.a: Cuando era niño, vivía en Toronto. Ahora vivo en Calgary.
It shows growth and helps set goals.
